name: Noor Haddad
bio: Spent six years on the import side before deciding she would rather know the farms than the spreadsheets. Buys everything we roast.

name: Eli Fournier
bio: Came for a two-week cover shift in 2021. Makes the galette that changes weekly and refuses to write the recipe down.
